content_zh:
赵卓荦握着自己的枪问：“他们在说什么？”
旁边战友：“杀？”
反正就是一些类似的单字。
连胜走了三四个小时没有动静, 不知道是被淘汰了, 还是有别的谋划。赵卓荦的游击队伍都已经壮大了一倍, 几乎快忘了这人。现在才想起来, 连胜说要给他们找人来着。
赵卓荦下巴一点：“过去看看。”
几人半弯着腰，隐匿身形快速往那边赶去。
声音越来越清晰，终于到达了激战区的边缘。几人躲在树后, 都能感受到流弹在眼前飞窜。
现场一片混战，根本分不清是敌是友。两边也完全自乱阵脚，嘴上吼着队友的名字, 但手上一点也没耽误的在乱射。
群众的心理达到了空前一致。机会难得, 先杀再说，哔哔个啥？
众人看得瞠目结舌, 这是怎么走向？
战友甲震惊道：“这怎么玩儿？谁才是队友？”
赵卓荦给武器上膛, 提醒道：“这其实是个人淘汰赛, 没有所谓的队友。”
这本来就是个人赛, 管他谁是谁, 站在场上的都应该是敌人。
几人忽然想通, 然后大笑着抄起武器，跟着加入战局。
不敢聚得太拢，以免成为靶子, 十几人分散了队伍, 互相间保持距离，散到四周。
这种类型的演习，每年的参与人员和学生的出场顺序都不尽相同，专业跨度又大，很难组织。像季方晓有一个大四的圈子，赵卓荦有一个大三的圈子，他们的圈子不愿意接纳太多会拖他们后腿的人。而又没有人能够组织这些“散兵”去对抗两队大佬，最后才演变出了大鱼吃小鱼的固定模式。
这一次，难得的冲突和反抗都有了，演习才真正的精彩起来。
连胜手中子弹接连出膛，如果单看她的射击频率，你会觉得这人是在乱来。但是，他们又眼睁睁看着那些目标依次倒下。
这是指挥系该有的水准吗？还是□□都能自动对焦了？除了献上膝盖，他们还能做什么？
于是鲁明远等人捡子弹捡得更卖力了。

山上的人员终于开始流动。
对于连胜他们来说，这些原本就是一群随机组合的散兵，他们的任务就是自我发挥，来去都随意。可对于季方晓来说，不管他们在这里拿了多少的人头分，团队的人数都在不断减少。
他打了一会儿，发觉不对。再这样下去，集结团队的优势就一点都没有了，甚至有一部分人还在自相残杀。
季方晓收枪，大声喊道：“整队！不要落入敌人的圈套，整队清点人数！”
他的声音在四周的嘈杂中并不明显，几乎出口就被鼎沸人声给湮没，但已经够了，旁边听见的人用更大的声音开始传告命令。
鲁明远挥臂一吼，指向前方：“狙击那个指挥！刚刚站中间说话的那个！火力包围边线，今天谁也不许走！”
乖乖的在里面死去活来不好吗？为什么非要离开呢？这一走，又是漫长的拉锯战。
连胜将枪头调转，对准所有要撤离的选手。她之前已经提醒过鲁明远，这样无组织无纪律的场面对他们最为有利，不趁机将他们的团队重挫，再难有第二次的机会。
只可惜人影一晃，连胜认不出谁才是季方晓，否则先拿下他，事情也会简单很多。
在鲁明远的号召引导下，边缘区域的火线开始密集。不管是敌是友，试图后撤的，一个也不放过。
因为战况激战，林子里尸体躺了一大片，监控室的教官严重人手不足，现场秩序一片混乱。而守在山下的教官，怕影响战局，不好强行进去带人，只能让尸体们自己匍匐着从小路出来，同时安排山下的人火速补上。
演习进度神速拉快。原先三小时才替换了三十几个人，现在不到三十分钟，左右已经下来五六十个了。
备战人数直接从后三十号扩展到后一百号，将已经休息的学生都叫了起来。
而那些刚刚下山的学生，虽然也只是上去走了一波，但被现场气氛狠狠震撼，阵亡之后依旧意犹未尽，和底下的同志们比手划脚的描述山上的战况，让他们听得蠢蠢欲动。
激战啊！梦想中的激战！就问哪个男生不激动！
方见尘坐在地上，对着山上嘶吼：“让我去！我可以不带一发子弹肉搏！让我去——！为什么我没赶上好时候！为什么——！”

content_en:
Zhao Zhuorun held his gun and asked, "What are they talking about?"
Comrade next to him: "Kill?"
Anyway, it’s just some similar words.
There has been no movement for three or four hours in a row. I don't know if they were eliminated or if they have other plans. Zhao Zhuorun's guerrilla team had doubled in size, and he had almost forgotten about this man. Only now do I remember that Lian Sheng said he wanted to find someone for them.
Zhao Zhuorun lowered his chin and said, "Go over and take a look."
Several people were half-bent, hiding their figures and rushing over there quickly.
The sound became clearer and clearer, and finally reached the edge of the fierce battle zone. Several people were hiding behind trees and could feel stray bullets flying in front of their eyes.
There was a melee at the scene, and it was impossible to tell whether it was an enemy or a friend. Both sides were completely in disarray, shouting the names of their teammates, but shooting randomly with their hands without any delay.
The psychology of the masses has reached an unprecedented level of unity. It's a rare opportunity, kill first and then talk, what's the beep?
Everyone was dumbfounded. How is this going?
Comrade A was shocked and said: "How is this happening? Who is the teammate?"
Zhao Zhuorun loaded the weapon and reminded: "This is actually a personal elimination match, there are no so-called teammates."
This is originally an individual match, no matter who he is, everyone standing on the field should be the enemy.
Several people suddenly figured it out, then laughed, picked up their weapons, and joined the battle.
Not daring to gather too closely, lest they become targets, a dozen or so people dispersed the group, keeping their distance from each other, and scattered around.
For this type of exercise, the order of participants and students' appearance is different every year, and the professional span is large, making it difficult to organize. For example, Ji Fangxiao has a circle of seniors, and Zhao Zhuorun has a circle of juniors. Their circles are unwilling to accept too many people who will hold them back. And no one could organize these "skirmishers" to fight against the two teams of bosses, and finally a fixed pattern of big fish eating small fish evolved.
This time, there were rare conflicts and resistance, and the exercise became truly exciting.
The bullets in Lian Sheng's hand were fired one after another. If you just looked at the frequency of her shooting, you would think that this person was acting randomly. However, they watched helplessly as those targets fell one after another.
Is this the standard a command system should have? Or can everything focus automatically? What else could they do but offer their knees?
So Lu Mingyuan and others worked harder to pick up bullets.
People on the mountain finally began to flow.
For Lian Sheng and the others, these were originally a group of randomly assembled skirmishers. Their task was to perform on their own, and they could come and go at will. But for Ji Fangxiao, no matter how many head points they got here, the number of people in the team was constantly decreasing.
He played for a while and realized something was wrong. If this continues, the advantage of gathering a team will be gone at all, and some people are even still killing each other.
Ji Fangxiao put away his gun and shouted loudly: "Form the team! Don't fall into the enemy's trap. Count the number of people in the team!"
His voice was not obvious in the surrounding noise, and it was almost drowned out by the roar of people, but it was enough. The people who heard him started to announce the order with a louder voice.
Lu Mingyuan waved his arms and shouted, pointing forward: "Snipe that conductor! The one who was standing in the middle talking just now! Fire surrounds the sideline, no one is allowed to leave today!"
Wouldn't it be better to just live and die in there? Why do you have to leave? This step is another long tug of war.
The winning streak turned the gun and aimed it at all the players who wanted to evacuate. She had reminded Lu Mingyuan before that such an unorganized and undisciplined situation was most beneficial to them. If they did not take the opportunity to severely defeat their team, it would be difficult to get a second chance.
It's a pity that Lian Sheng couldn't recognize who Ji Fangxiao was as soon as the figure flashed, otherwise things would have been much easier if he had been captured first.
Under the guidance of Lu Mingyuan's call, the line of fire in the edge area began to intensify. No matter whether they are friends or foes, no one will be spared who is trying to retreat.
because of warThere was a fierce battle, and there was a large area of ​​corpses lying in the forest. The instructors in the control room were seriously short of manpower, and the order at the scene was in chaos. The instructor who was guarding the bottom of the mountain was afraid of affecting the war situation and could not forcefully go in to take people. He could only let the corpses crawl out from the path by themselves, and at the same time arranged for the people at the bottom of the mountain to quickly replace them.
The progress of the exercise accelerated rapidly. It used to take three hours to replace more than thirty people, but now in less than thirty minutes, about fifty or sixty people have come down.
The number of people preparing for the battle was directly expanded from the last 30 to the last 100, and all the students who had rested were called up.
And those students who had just come down the mountain, even though they had only gone up for a while, were deeply shocked by the atmosphere. Even after they were killed in battle, they were still unsatisfied. They gesticulated with the comrades below and described the battle situation on the mountain, making them eager to listen.
Fierce fighting! The fierce battle of your dreams! Just ask which boy is not excited!
Fang Jianchen sat on the ground and shouted at the mountain: "Let me go! I can fight hand-to-hand without a bullet! Let me go -! Why didn't I catch up with the good time! Why -!"
